title: AdaCultureSafe: Adaptive Cultural Safety Grounded by Cultural Knowledge in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.08275v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the global proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs), cultural safety, defined as the ability to generate respectful and appropriate responses across diverse cultures, becomes critical for responsible AI deployment. However, existing research often treats cultural safety and cultural knowledge in isolation. It remains unclear whether cultural safety is grounded in understanding varying cultural knowledge to enable LLMs to adaptively yield respectful and appropriate responses across diverse cultures, which trigger ethical concerns in cross-cultural scenarios. In this work, we introduce AdaCultureSafe, a dataset designed to jointly evaluate cultural safety and knowledge. Through AdaCultureSafe, we reveal a critical insight: \textit{a significant decoupling exists between cultural safety and cultural knowledge proficiency. Although LLMs possess rich cultural knowledge, they fail to leverage it to improve cultural safety.}

translated_title: AdaCultureSafe：基于文化知识的大语言模型自适应文化安全性
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）在全球范围内的普及，文化安全性——即在多元文化中生成尊重且恰当回应的能力——已成为负责任AI部署的关键。然而，现有研究往往将文化安全性与文化知识割裂处理。目前尚不清楚文化安全性是否植根于对不同文化知识的理解，从而使大语言模型能够自适应地在多元文化中产生尊重且恰当的回应，这在跨文化场景中引发了伦理层面的担忧。在这项工作中，我们提出了AdaCultureSafe，这是一个旨在联合评估文化安全性与文化知识的数据集。通过AdaCultureSafe，我们揭示了一个关键洞察：文化安全性与文化知识熟练度之间存在显著的脱节。尽管大语言模型拥有丰富的文化知识，但它们未能利用这些知识来提升文化安全性。
tldr: 本文提出了AdaCultureSafe数据集，首次联合评估大语言模型的文化安全性与文化知识，并揭示了一个关键发现：模型虽拥有丰富的文化知识，却未能将其用于提升文化安全性，两者之间存在显著脱节。
